spec.claim_summary: Go long BTC on 4H when Supertrend flips from downtrend to uptrend, with an ATR stop, a 0.75R first target with partial close and breakeven move, and exit the remainder when Supertrend flips back to downtrend.
assumptions: Supertrend settings not stated, used default ATR length 10 and multiplier 3.0.
ATR stop-loss length not stated, used default stop_atr_period 14.
ATR stop-loss multiplier not stated, used 1.5 as concrete value.

NOT EXPRESSIBLE: partial exit closing half position at 0.75R and moving stop loss to breakeven after first target left out; tested core holds full position with ATR stop until opposite Supertrend flip.
No exit timeframe ambiguity: Supertrend exit uses same 4H bars.
Claim cites 2020-01-02 to 2023-01-05 as backtest context, recorded in claimed not as rule filter.

evidence.quote: you enter into a long position
Once Supertrend changes from a downtrend to a uptrend, you enter into a long position.
Once Supertrend changes from a uptrend to a downtrend, you close the other half of the initial long position.
The stop loss will be defined by the atr stop loss

audit_majors: take_profit_r: Spec omits the 0.75R first target closing half the position and moving stop to breakeven. Marking it NOT EXPRESSIBLE in assumptions does not excuse it because holding full size to opposite flip with fixed ATR stop tests a different payoff.
